comparison.objective: Pass a tall canister over a shelf fence under low overhead clearance and stand it upright behind the fence.
comparison.physical_skill: Tilt-to-clear insertion, base placement, and in-place reorientation under a height constraint.
comparison.success_condition: Canister is released, upright on its base behind the fence, inside side bounds, and still.
comparison.reason: This is constrained whole-object insertion and stand-up, not an adjustable-device commissioning procedure.
